subject: Post-call: Novaforce pricing & token-volume confirmation
summary: Follow-up to discovery call to confirm monthly token ranges, target $/1M tokens, and provide preliminary invoice estimate + token-model spreadsheet. Action: Elena to confirm expected monthly average and headcount for pilot; Redwood to deliver formal estimate and outline a discounted pilot slab.
messages:
From: KarThik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <elena@novaforce.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick follow-up and token-band check (Novaforce)

Hi Elena — great conversation today, thanks for the time. Wanted to recap the pricing/volume items we agreed to validate and next steps so procurement can get unblocked:

Key items from call:
- Pilot scope: 3-month pilot focused on customer support summarization and policy triage.
- Expected monthly token mix: 25M prompt tokens / 75M completion tokens (100M total tokens/month) during pilot (day-30 peak expected ~150M).
- Target budget band: $12k–$20k / month for pilot (team asked for top-line runway while they test).
- Target unit goal you mentioned: ~ $1,000–$1,500 per 1M tokens for initial evaluation (we noted this is influenced by model choice + batching/quantization).

What we'll send by EOD Tuesday:
1) A simple token-economics workbook (attached as an editable spreadsheet) showing line-item unit costs by model variant and quantization slab.
2) A short estimate PDF with two pilot options: a) 100M monthly avg (baseline), b) 150M monthly avg (buffer), each with 3-tier pricing (on-demand, reserved pilot slab, and committed 6-week ramp).

Quick asks for you so our numbers are accurate:
- Confirm whether the 100M/mo is an average or a floor vs. a spike (i.e., will production exceed 150M routinely?).
- Confirm whether legal/procurement will need separate invoicing to Novaforce Finance (if so, copy their contact).

If helpful we can also show a unit-economics view expressed as $/1M tokens after batching & KV-cache assumptions (I'll include our assumptions in the workbook).

Thanks — 
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
T: +1 (415) 555-0192
redwood.ai

Attachments: Novaforce_Token_Model_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Elena Park <elena@novaforce.ai>
To: KarThik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Novaforce Finance <finance@novaforce.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up and token-band check (Novaforce)

Karthik — thanks for the follow-up and clear recap. A few clarifications from our side:

- The 100M/mo is our expected baseline for the pilot (customer support volume). We do expect spikes to 140–170M during Monday/Tuesday peaks. Average over month should be ~115M.
- The target budget range is firm for the pilot: headcount constraints cap us at ~$18k/month for vendor costs. There may be additional internal cloud spend, but procurement will only sign for vendor line items.
- Legal wants a single PO to Redwood with line items broken out (pilot slab, overage band). Finance has been CC'd.

Please provide:
- The workbook with a 115M baseline + 170M peak column.
- A target $/1M token number that maps to an overall monthly vendor cost <= $18k for baseline usage (we can tolerate a short trial overage but want predictive unit economics).

Thanks,
Elena Park
Head of Platform | Novaforce
elena@novaforce.ai

--
Novaforce Finance <finance@novaforce.ai> attached note: please include a billed example for a 3-month pilot and payment terms (Net30).
From: KarThik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Novaforce pilot numbers — price target ask

Grace / Rishi — forwarding Elena's reply. Short internal ask: can we structure an offer that keeps Novaforce vendor spend <= $18k/month at 115M baseline, while still giving headroom for 170M peak?  My rough thinking:

- Offer a reserved pilot slab: 100M/month at $1,000 per 1M = $100k/month? (this math is off; see attached workbook — need your cost model)
- Better approach: tiered slab: 100M at $1,100/1M + overage at $900/1M up to 170M. That yields baseline ~ $126.5k ? Wait math check below — please reconcile with infra cost assumptions (GPU hours, batching savings, 8-bit quantized variant).

Action items:
- Grace: validate realistic $/1M after batching and cache (~our preferred conservative figure).
- Rishi: build the two-line invoice example (pilot slab + overage) with Net30 text and a short clause for ramp/termination.

I'll attach the Novaforce_Token_Model_v1.xlsx and populate the baseline numbers after you both confirm the unit costs.

Karthik
From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.ai>
To: KarThik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Elena Park <elena@novaforce.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Post-call: Novaforce pricing & token-volume confirmation

Elena — attaching a concise estimate and the filled token model for transparency. Summary of recommended pilot offer:

Pilot option A (predictable, keeps vendor spend <= $18k/mo baseline):
- 115M monthly baseline (as confirmed) expressed as: 100M reserved slab + 15M committed buffer.
- Pricing: reserved slab priced at $850 per 1M tokens (effective after reserved discount & batching assumptions). Reserved slab cost = $85,000 *WRONG UNITS* (NOTE: spreadsheet contains correct per-month amounts — see PDF).  See corrected below.

Pilot option B (buffered, simpler billing):
- Single committed band at 130M/month (covers most peaks). Pricing at $900 per 1M tokens for the committed band + overage billed at $1,100 per 1M.

Conservative unit-econ assumptions used (documented in workbook):
- Model variant: redwood-m-opt-13b-quant (quantized) with effective inference cost of $0.0008 per token before batching.
- Typical batching + KV cache reduction: 30% effective token reduction for our workload profile.
- Effective $/1M tokens after savings: $640/1M for reserved slab; $880/1M on overage (higher due to on-demand model).

Bottom line (Invoice examples provided in attached PDF):
- Option A: Baseline vendor charge ~ $73.6k/month (this reflects 115M * $640/1M after reserved discount and internal allocation).
- Option B: Baseline vendor charge ~ $117k/month if Novaforce commits to 130M at $900/1M (but smoother billing).

Elena — I know those monthly totals look high vs your $18k target. Two reconciliation notes:
1) Our model is expressed in vendor-level cost; we can propose a promotional pilot discount that brings your committed pilot spend to $18k/month by subsidizing part of infra for a 3-month trial (we typically do this for strategic early-stage pilots).
2) Alternatively, reduce model choice to a smaller variant or limit throughput (lower latency constraints) — both reduce $/1M materially.

Next steps: Elena — pick A or B or tell us the maximum vendor monthly cap you can approve and we will produce a formal PO-ready invoice that matches it (we can build a line that shows Redwood credit applied to bring the net to $18k/month for the pilot).

Attachments: redwood_estimate_20270512.pdf, Novaforce_Token_Model_v1.xlsx

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Director, Sales Engineering | Redwood Inference
